method.paired: Three sequential before/after pairs. Each arm launches isolated hardware Edge, loads one production-kernel bundle, and creates a fresh context for each case. 1280x800 CSS, DPR 1, 60 warmup frames, six measured seconds. Production 120Hz accumulator with 50ms dt cap. Full-quality GPU lighting and water. No fixed-tick shortcut, adaptive reduction, or motion observer.
method.units: Update/draw CPU milliseconds per displayed frame, with observed ticks/frame. Per-tick update is total update CPU divided by total physics ticks; it separates solver throughput from catch-up amplification. CPU drawing excludes asynchronous GPU completion.
method.scope: Production simulation, camera, fonts and renderer. Excludes React UI, account/storage work, audio and hardware input latency. Collision-free diagnostic placements with ordinary controller inputs are not a completed normal-control route or a feel/readability review.
method.stress: One 80 world-unit/sec horizontal impulse at 70% material distance on each of the seven ropes. Same object counts; explicit stress probe, not a claim about a recorded player route.
method.sustained: One 60-second neutral-player run per authored revision. The Rbot uses normal autonomous behavior and can interact with the player. Five-second windows and state history retained.
method.profiles: Separate 1ms V8 sampling profiles, diagnostic only. Attribution is time-weighted non-idle samples. Inclusive categories overlap and must not be added together. Profiled FPS is excluded from timing claims.
method.variability: An earlier three-episode scan varied substantially; a host snapshot afterward showed about 30% total CPU use with other Chrome and SenseCE activity. No unrelated process was changed or terminated. The final alternating pairs are the reported comparison, not a guarantee of universal FPS or an isolation of shortening from the concurrent chimney geometry edit.
